policy_name: Regional Building Codes for Factory-Built Structures
summary: Advisory committee develops regional codes; State Housing Board rules due 2026-07-01 and preempt conflicting local codes; counties/municipalities may not exclude factory-built structures or apply stricter standards than to site-built homes in the same residential zones. Funding = $600,000 transfer + $182,264 appropriation. VERIFY rule adoption status.

policy_name: Minimum design criteria for HUD-Code homes placed in Colorado
summary: HUD-Code homes must meet Wind Zone 1, Thermal Zone 3 and a 30 psf roof load to be sold/installed in Colorado. Rule citation to verify.
